context: Mei and Aoi plan to fix a problem together.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (向かう/話し合い/させる/おっしゃる/ライト) in natural home.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 店の問題、話し合いで解決したいね。
lines.en: Let's solve the shop's problem through discussion.
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うん、前向きに向かおうね。
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 店長は、改善したいとおっしゃってたよ。
lines.en: The manager said they want to improve it.
lines.style: cheerful barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: みんなを、安心させたいね。
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 暗いから、ライトを足そうって話したの。
lines.en: Since it's dark, we talked about adding lights.
lines.style: engaged barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ライトを増やせば、明るくなるね。
lines.en: More lights will brighten it up.
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 話し合いを、続けようね。
lines.style: cheerful barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 良い方向に、向かいそうだね!
lines.en: It looks like it's heading in a good direction!
lines.style: bright woman voice, soft warm affectionate closing delivery throughout
